import hashlib,json,os,pathlib,platform,re,shutil,signal,socket,statistics,subprocess,tempfile,time
root=pathlib.Path('/Users/isavita/git/lean-net');binary=root/'.lake/build/bin/lean-net-echo'
paths=['c/reactor_posix.c','c/reactor.h','c/reactor_group.c','LeanNet/Echo/ReactorServer.lean','LeanNet/Reactor/Basic.lean','lakefile.lean','test/bench_echo.c','test/bench_echo.py']
report={'binary_sha256':hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'git_head':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=root,text=True).strip(),'environment':{'platform':platform.platform(),'cpu':'Apple M2','logical_cpus':os.cpu_count()},'source_sha256':{p:hashlib.sha256((root/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in paths},'trace_source_sha256':hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path('/tmp/lean-net-adopt-trace.c').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'trace_source':pathlib.Path('/tmp/lean-net-adopt-trace.c').read_text(),'driver_source':pathlib.Path(__file__).read_text(),'method':'Disposable DYLD kevent/recv/close tracer: first successful connected-socket read registration by kqueue, owning thread, positive recv count/bytes and read thread; four independent native clients, one startup probe. Timing is diagnostic only.','workers':8,'client_processes':4,'connections_per_client':100,'requests_per_client':200000,'payload_bytes':16}
report['driver_source_sha256']=hashlib.sha256(report['driver_source'].encode()).hexdigest()
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='lean-net-adoption-trace-') as d:
 d=pathlib.Path(d); serverpath=d/'server';clientpath=d/'client';shutil.copy2(binary,serverpath)
 subprocess.run(['cc','-O3','-std=c11','-Wall','-Wextra','-Wpedantic','-Werror',str(root/'test/bench_echo.c'),'-o',str(clientpath)],check=True)
 with socket.socket() as s:s.bind(('127.0.0.1',0));port=s.getsockname()[1]
 with tempfile.TemporaryFile(mode='w+') as log:
  env=os.environ.copy();env['DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES']='/tmp/lean-net-adopt-trace.dylib'
  server=subprocess.Popen([str(serverpath),str(port),'8'],stdout=log,stderr=log,env=env)
  try:
   for _ in range(100):
    if server.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError('server startup exit')
    try:
     with socket.create_connection(('127.0.0.1',port),timeout=.1):break
    except OSError:time.sleep(.01)
   start=time.monotonic();clients=[subprocess.Popen([str(clientpath),str(port),'100','200000','16'],stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,text=True) for _ in range(4)];samples=[]
   while any(p.poll() is None for p in clients):
    r=subprocess.run(['ps','-p',','.join(str(p.pid) for p in [server,*clients]),'-o','pid=,pcpu=,rss='],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True)
    processes=[]
    for line in r.stdout.splitlines():
     pid,cpu,rss=line.split();processes.append({'pid':int(pid),'role':'server' if int(pid)==server.pid else 'client','cpu_percent':float(cpu),'rss_kib':int(rss)})
    samples.append({'seconds':time.monotonic()-start,'processes':processes});time.sleep(.25)
   report['elapsed_upper_bound_seconds']=time.monotonic()-start;report['loads']=[]
   for p in clients:
    out,err=p.communicate(timeout=2)
    if p.returncode:raise RuntimeError(err)
    report['loads'].append(json.loads(out))
  finally:
   if server.poll() is None:server.send_signal(signal.SIGINT)
   report['server_exit']=server.wait(timeout=5);log.seek(0);logtext=log.read()
   if report['server_exit']:raise RuntimeError(logtext)
 report['worker_distribution']=[dict(zip(['queue','adopted','thread','positive_reads','read_bytes','read_thread'],map(int,m))) for m in re.findall(r'ADOPT_TRACE queue=(\d+) adopted=(\d+) thread=(\d+) positive_reads=(\d+) read_bytes=(\d+) read_thread=(\d+)',logtext)]
 report['samples']=samples
 cpus=[p['cpu_percent'] for s in samples if s['seconds']>=1 for p in s['processes'] if p['role']=='server']
 report['server_cpu_percent_median']=statistics.median(cpus);report['server_cpu_percent_max']=max(cpus)
 report['raw_log']=logtext
 pathlib.Path('/tmp/lean-net-adoption-diagnostic-raw.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
 distribution=report['worker_distribution']
 print(json.dumps(distribution),flush=True)
 assert len(distribution)==8 and len({w['thread'] for w in distribution})==8
 assert all(w['thread']==w['read_thread'] and w['positive_reads']>0 for w in distribution)
 assert sum(w['adopted'] for w in distribution)==401
 assert sum(w['read_bytes'] for w in distribution)==800000*16
 assert max(w['adopted'] for w in distribution)-min(w['adopted'] for w in distribution)==1
 assert hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==report['binary_sha256']
 report['validation']='All8 distinct real Lean workers registered and read their own sockets; 401 adoptions include one startup probe, balanced50/51; 12,800,000 bytes match800,000 verified16-byte echoes; cleanSIGINT exit. Instrumented timing is not a throughput acceptance gate or linear-scaling claim.'
(root/'test/benchmarks/echo-reactor-handoff-macos-m2-worker-distribution.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
